name: Frost Serpent
fantasy: A long, wingless dragon of pale ice-blue scale with crystal antlers and a ridge of ice shards. Swims over the ground, strikes with claw and fang and lashes its tail in a full turn.

directions.name: Glacier
directions.desc: Tombs of ice and a hide of it: lock them down, then break them.

skills.name: Frost Breath
skills.desc: The serpent lowers its head and breathes a freezing gale over everything in a cone 7 metres ahead for over a second: cold damage again and again, chilling (slowing) them; the ground frosts over and ice bursts up where it ends.

skills.name: Glacial Tomb
skills.desc: Seal the foe nearest the pointer, and all within 2.5 metres of it, in ice for 1.6 seconds. Then the tomb shatters: 180% weapon damage to each sealed foe and 90% to everything else within 3 metres.
skills.role: lock a pack, then shatter it

skills.name: Crushing Coil
skills.desc: Whip your body round in a full coil: 130% weapon damage to everything within 4.2 metres, slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds. Chilled foes are crushed for 30% more.

skills.name: Rime Lance
skills.desc: Breathe a line of ice spikes 10 metres ahead: 125% weapon damage to every foe on it, chilling them. A foe already chilled is frozen solid for 1 second.

rites.name: Permafrost
rites.text: Every {n}th hit on a chilled foe freezes it solid for {secs} seconds.

rites.name: Brittle
rites.text: Chilled foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

rites.name: Rending Claws
rites.text: Claws and bites deal +{dmg:attack}%; +{crit}% critical chance.

rites.name: Primal Fury
rites.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds, up to {stacks} times.

rites.name: Deep Freeze
rites.text: Glacial Tomb seals {tomb_r}% wider, holds {tomb_t} s longer and shatters {dmg:s_tomb}% harder.

rites.name: Iron Coils
rites.text: Crushing Coil reaches {coil_r}% further, hits {dmg:s_coil}% harder and heals {coil_shield}% of your life for each foe it crushes.

rites.name: Spear of Winter
rites.text: Rime Lance runs {lance_len}% further, freezes {lance_freeze} s longer and hits {dmg:s_lance}% harder.

rites.name: Frozen Barbs
rites.text: Foes that strike you take {pct}% of the blow back as cold.

rites.name: Shatterpoint
rites.text: Chilled foes that die burst into ice shards: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m, chilling.

rites.name: Heart of the Glacier
rites.text: A blow that would kill you leaves you at {life}% life inside a shell of ice instead (once every {secs} seconds).
